name: ezBookkeeping
description: ezBookkeeping is a lightweight, self-hosted personal finance / bookkeeping app with a modern responsive web UI and PWA support. Supports multi-currency, transaction categories, accounts, statistics and charts, import/export, and 2FA. Defaults to SQLite stored under /ezbookkeeping/data. For MySQL/PostgreSQL set the EBK_DATABASE_* variables (any ezbookkeeping.ini option can be overridden via an EBK_SECTION_OPTION environment variable). The container runs as UID/GID 1000:1000, so the host appdata folder must be owned by 1000:1000. Before first start, open the Unraid terminal and run: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/ezbookkeeping/{data,storage,log,conf} chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/ezbookkeeping If you change the host paths in this template, run chown -R 1000:1000 against those paths instead.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent data directory. Holds the SQLite database when using the default database backend.

paths.name: Storage
paths.description: Object storage for user uploads (avatars, transaction pictures, etc.).

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Optional. Mount a folder containing a custom ezbookkeeping.ini to override the built-in config. Leave blank to use defaults plus EBK_* environment variables.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: HTTP port for the ezBookkeeping web interface.

variables.name: Security Secret Key
variables.description: Random string used to encrypt sensitive user data. CHANGE this to a long random string before first start (e.g. openssl rand -hex 32). Changing it later will invalidate existing tokens/2FA secrets.

variables.name: Server Domain
variables.description: The domain or IP used to reach the WebUI (e.g. ezbookkeeping.example.com or 192.168.1.50). Used to build correct URLs in emails and the PWA.

variables.name: Enable Registration
variables.description: Allow new users to register accounts from the login page. Set to false after creating your own account to prevent strangers from signing up.

variables.name: Database Type
variables.description: Database backend: sqlite3 (default, no extra setup), mysql, or postgres. When set to mysql/postgres, also fill in the Database Host/Name/User/Password fields below.

variables.name: Database Host
variables.description: Only used when Database Type is mysql or postgres. host:port of the database server — e.g. mariadb:3306 if you run MariaDB as a separate Unraid container on the bridge network.

variables.name: Database Name
variables.description: Only used when Database Type is mysql or postgres. Name of the database to use (must already exist on the DB server).

variables.name: Database User
variables.description: Only used when Database Type is mysql or postgres. Username with full privileges on the database above.

variables.name: Database Password
variables.description: Only used when Database Type is mysql or postgres. Password for the database user.

variables.name: Log Mode
variables.description: Optional. Log output mode: console, file, or console,file. Leave blank for the image default.
